10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03956.zh:
基于已捕获的部分正文，未获取的细节不作补写。

该研究利用1,3-二噻烷的硫原子接力作用，将炔基二噻烷与2H-氮杂环丙烯先转化为顺式稠合的张力双环氮杂环丙烷，再通过不同的环重排分流制备含硫半饱和稠合吡啶和吡咯。初始形式[3+2]环化采用NaOtBu/DMSO，在室温下5分钟完成模型反应；晶体结构支持顺式产物构型。芳基、杂芳基及部分烷基底物适用，但文中考察的炔丙基二噻烷不反应。

后续采用AcOH促进扩环，或以InBr3/DDQ组合促进氧化缩环。检测到的二氢吡啶鎓中间体和缩环过程中的苯甲醛，为不同重排路径提供线索；涉及硫迁移、断键及芳构化的完整过程仍是作者提出的机理。该策略以共同的张力中间体实现杂环骨架分流，二噻烷还可作为后续可脱除的合成辅助基。含InBr3的整条分流路线不能统称为完全无金属。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03956.en:
Based on the captured partial text; uncaptured details are not reconstructed.

The study uses the sulfur atoms of a 1,3-dithiane as a relay: alkynyl dithianes and 2H-azirines first furnish cis-fused strained bicyclic aziridines, which subsequently diverge through ring rearrangements to sulfur-containing semisaturated fused pyridines or pyrroles. The initial formal [3+2] cyclization uses NaOtBu in DMSO and completes the model reaction in 5 minutes at room temperature; crystallography supports the cis product configuration. Aryl, heteroaryl and some alkyl substrates are accommodated, whereas the examined propargyl dithiane is unreactive.

Subsequent AcOH treatment promotes expansion, while InBr3/DDQ promotes oxidative contraction. Observation of a dihydropyridinium intermediate and detection of benzaldehyde during contraction provide mechanistic clues; the full sequences involving sulfur migration, bond cleavage and aromatization remain the authors' proposals. The approach diversifies heterocyclic skeletons from a common strained intermediate, and the dithiane can subsequently be removed as a synthetic handle. The indium-containing divergent sequence should not be described as entirely metal-free.
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03956.evidenceAudit: Checked initial cis cyclization, NaOtBu/DMSO model, substrate boundary and AcOH versus InBr3/DDQ divergence. Distinguished detected intermediate/benzaldehyde from the complete proposed migrations; did not label indium-containing steps metal-free. Bilingual scientific claims reconciled.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03894.zh:
基于 Abstract：该研究以蒽衍生物和杂芳基腈为反应组分，通过可见光诱导的去芳构化杂芳基化构建带有杂芳基的多环产物。摘要将反应归因于能量转移与电子转移的协同，由生成的自由基阴离子参与后续自由基–自由基偶联。作者报告该方法适用于多种多环芳烃和氰基芳烃，具有良好的官能团兼容性，并能以较高收率获得产物。

其合成意义在于将芳香体系的去芳构化与含氮杂芳基片段引入相结合。生物活性及荧光性质调节是相关结构的潜在用途，不能等同于本研究已经证明药效或器件性能。当前仅按摘要级证据发布，不补写具体光催化剂、条件、收率数值或正文机理实验。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03894.en:
Abstract-based: the study combines anthracene derivatives with heteroarylnitriles in visible-light-induced dearomative heteroarylation to construct heteroaryl-substituted polycyclic products. The abstract attributes the transformation to combined energy transfer and electron transfer, with the resulting radical anions participating in subsequent radical–radical coupling. The authors report compatibility with various polycyclic arenes and cyanoarenes, useful functional-group tolerance and high product yields.

The synthetic contribution is the combination of arene dearomatization with incorporation of nitrogen-containing heteroaryl units. Biological and fluorescence-related uses are potential applications of such structures, not established therapeutic or device performance in this study. Only abstract-level evidence is used here; the photocatalyst, detailed conditions, numerical yields and full-text mechanistic experiments are not reconstructed.
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03894.evidenceAudit: Used the actual first abstract only despite a larger capture section also labelled abstract. No unsupported catalyst, conditions or numerical yields; mechanistic attribution and potential applications remain at abstract depth. Bilingual facts checked.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03584.zh:
基于 Abstract：该研究通过稳定、可操作的去芳构化噁嗪并氮杂芳烃中间体，实现吡啶的间位选择性C–H苯硒化。反应采用TCCA促进，不需要金属催化剂，在空气中和温和条件下制备3-(苯硒基)吡啶，摘要报告的最高收率为90%。位点选择性依赖预先形成的去芳构化吡啶衍生物，而不是笼统的直接吡啶C–H活化。

作者还报告了从吡啶出发的一锅可放大操作，以及含吡啶药物和天然产物衍生物的后期修饰。该方法为吡啶间位引入含硒合成片段提供了路线；当前不补写各步骤用量、详细底物范围或未捕获的机理控制实验。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03584.en:
Abstract-based: the study enables meta-selective C–H phenylselenylation of pyridines through bench-stable dearomatized oxazino-azine intermediates. TCCA promotes the transformation without a metal catalyst, furnishing 3-(phenylselanyl)pyridines under mild, open-air conditions; the abstract reports yields up to 90%. Positional selectivity relies on the preformed dearomatized pyridine derivative rather than an unspecified direct pyridine C–H activation process.

The authors also report a scalable one-pot operation starting from pyridines and late-stage functionalization of pyridine-containing drug and natural-product derivatives. This provides access to meta-selenium-functionalized pyridine building blocks. Individual reagent loadings, detailed scope and uncaptured mechanistic controls are not reconstructed.
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03584.evidenceAudit: Checked TCCA promotion, open-air metal-free scope, meta product identity and up-to-90% abstract claim. Scalability and late-stage derivatization kept at abstract depth; no full-text claims imported. Bilingual facts checked.

10.1126/science.aeg5583.zh:
该研究以带有PEG链的肽两亲分子为单体，通过水相种子介导的活性超分子聚合，制备长度及正负电荷分段可控制的纤维状组装体。作者先将已有纤维超声处理为短种子，再调节加入的单体/种子比例延长纤维，并通过依次加入相反电荷的单体形成中央正电、两端负电等分段结构；单体耗尽后末端进入休眠状态，补加单体可继续生长。组装体整体摩尔质量可达到十亿道尔顿量级，这指的是非共价组装体，不是单根共价聚合物链。

冷冻电镜、荧光成像、种子延伸和结构对照共同支持长度控制。去掉PEG后短纤维会继续长大或聚集，而足够长的末端PEG有助于稳定纤维长度；游离PEG和不同肽序列的行为也不同。作者提出，局部高浓度PEG在纤维末端形成动态封端，抑制融合或熟化；沿纤维保持非扭转的β片层核心也是稳定分段和可控延伸的重要设计条件，该机制不能推广到所有肽组装体。

在神经元培养实验中，正电片段与细胞膜结合，连接的负电片段因电荷排斥保持较高动态性；这种空间分段与更广泛的神经突生长和突触活动相关。这是培养体系中的结构–功能结果，不能直接推断临床神经修复效果。
10.1126/science.aeg5583.en:
The study uses PEG-bearing peptide amphiphiles in aqueous seeded living supramolecular polymerization to control fibril length and the spatial segmentation of positive and negative charge. Preformed fibrils are sonicated into short seeds and elongated by adjusting the monomer-to-seed ratio. Sequential addition of oppositely charged monomers produces architectures such as a positive central segment flanked by negative segments. Ends become dormant after monomer depletion and resume growth when monomer is supplied. The collective molar mass can reach the billion-dalton range; this describes a noncovalent assembly, not an individual covalent polymer chain.

Cryogenic electron microscopy, fluorescence imaging, seeded growth and structural controls support length control. Removing PEG permits continued growth or aggregation of short fibrils, whereas sufficiently long terminal PEG helps stabilize fibril length; free PEG and different peptide sequences behave differently. The authors propose dynamic end-capping by locally concentrated PEG that suppresses fusion or ripening. An untwisted β-sheet core along the fibril is also an important design requirement for stable segmentation and controlled extension; the mechanism should not be generalized to all peptide assemblies.

In cultured neurons, positive segments associate with cell membranes while connected negative segments remain highly dynamic through electrostatic repulsion. This spatial architecture is associated with extensive neurite growth and synaptic activity. These are structure–function findings in cell culture, not established clinical neural-repair efficacy.
10.1126/science.aeg5583.evidenceAudit: Read seeded growth, charge segmentation, PEG removal/length and sequence/twist controls, capping proposal and neuronal experiments. Billion-dalton mass correctly denotes the assembly, not a covalent chain. Kept mechanistic proposals and cell-culture observations distinct; no clinical-efficacy claim.

该研究通过银催化串联反应，将含邻氨基芳基的炔丙醇衍生物与羰基化合物组装为吡喃稠合吲哚型伪天然产物，并通过酸添加剂和温度切换两类结构异构体。芳香醛条件A采用CF3COOAg/TsOH，在DCM中室温反应；不加酸、改用DCE并升温则得到条件B对应的另一类产物。该分流涉及整套反应条件的变化，不能简单归因于一个因素。

芳香醛适用范围包含给电子、吸电子及卤素取代，位阻较大时收率下降；靛红衍生物可形成螺环产物，但需要较高温度。所测试的脂肪醛没有检出目标产物；吡啶甲醛和糠醛的目标产物未能因纯化困难而获得，后者不等于反应完全不发生。作者提出银促进环化及后续成键/氧环化的不同串联顺序，完整路径仍是机理解释。

部分产物开展了肿瘤细胞增殖、细胞周期及凋亡相关实验。化合物3t对若干肿瘤细胞具有微摩尔级抑制活性，但这属于体外先导化合物筛选结果，不是已证实的抗肿瘤药物疗效。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03671.en:
Based on the captured partial text; uncaptured details are not reconstructed.

The study uses silver-catalyzed cascades to assemble ortho-aminoaryl-containing propargylic alcohol derivatives and carbonyl compounds into pyran-fused indole pseudo-natural products. Acid additive and temperature switch between two structural-isomer families. With aromatic aldehydes, condition A uses CF3COOAg/TsOH in DCM at room temperature; omitting acid, changing to DCE and increasing temperature gives the alternative products under condition B. Divergence involves a combination of conditions rather than one isolated factor.

The aromatic-aldehyde scope includes electron-rich, electron-poor and halogenated substrates, with reduced yields for bulkier partners. Isatin derivatives furnish spiro products at elevated temperature. The tested aliphatic aldehydes give no detectable target product; products from pyridine carboxaldehyde and furfural could not be obtained because of purification difficulties, which is not equivalent to no reaction. Different sequences of silver-assisted cyclization and subsequent bond formation/oxygen cyclization are proposed; the complete pathways remain mechanistic interpretations.

Selected products were evaluated in tumor-cell proliferation, cell-cycle and apoptosis-related experiments. Compound 3t shows micromolar inhibitory activity against several tumor-cell lines. These are in vitro lead-screening findings, not established anticancer-drug efficacy.
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03671.evidenceAudit: Verified acid/solvent/temperature divergence and scope boundaries. Distinguished undetected aliphatic products from heteroaryl purification difficulty. Retained silver-assisted sequence as proposal and biological results as in vitro. Bilingual facts checked without mixing isolated and NMR yields.

该研究发展黄酮的电化学分流转化，分别制备二氢黄酮醇和3-碘黄酮。两条路线以不同方式改变黄酮C2–C3区域的饱和度和官能化形式，为同一类天然产物骨架提供互补的修饰方向。作者强调利用电化学条件控制转化，而不依赖额外的过渡金属催化剂；这不等于不使用金属电极。

捕获的底物研究显示若干取代黄酮能够参与反应，并展示天然黄酮的衍生化应用。两类产物来自不同条件组合，不能把分流简单描述为只改变一个试剂。当前摘要保留可核实的核心转化和合成用途，不补写未逐项核实的电极配置、电流、原子来源或完整机理。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03424.en:
Based on the captured partial text; uncaptured details are not reconstructed.

The study develops divergent electrochemical transformations of flavones to dihydroflavonols and 3-iodoflavones. The two routes alter saturation and functionalization in the C2–C3 region in different ways, providing complementary derivatization pathways for the same natural-product scaffold class. The authors use electrochemical conditions to control the transformations without an additional transition-metal catalyst; this is not a statement that no metal electrode is used.

The captured scope shows reactions of substituted flavones and applications to natural-flavone derivatization. Different combinations of conditions lead to the two product classes, so divergence should not be reduced to a single-reagent switch. This summary retains the verified core transformations and synthetic applications without reconstructing electrode configurations, currents, atom origins or a complete mechanism that have not been individually verified.
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03424.evidenceAudit: Second pass rejected the initial unsupported electrode, current, electrolyte/solvent and isotope assignments before any production write. Published account deliberately narrowed to captured core divergent transformations and synthetic applications, with no claim of a uniquely proven radical pathway.

该研究以醇驱动的配位调控，将多孔有机聚合物上原有的三膦配位Ru位点转化为单膦配位Ru位点，用于无需外加碱的胺与醇N-烷基化。作者将活性构型表述为[RuH2Cl2(Ph-CHO)(PPh3)]，其策略在于改变金属局部配位环境，而不只是增加Ru负载量。

单膦体系的报道TOF为323 h−1，表观活化能为70.1 kJ mol−1；三膦对照分别为145 h−1和103.3 kJ mol−1。循环使用及表征显示，经过10次循环后Ru仍保持原子级分散。结合中间体、光谱和计算分析，作者提出二氢化物转移机理，并将活性提升与β-H消除能垒降低联系起来；活性结构和速率决定步骤的解释不能仅由较高TOF反推得到。

该工作提供了调节多相单原子Ru催化剂配位数以促进有机N-烷基化的策略。高活性和可循环性对应所报道的模型及测试范围，不代表所有胺和所有醇都适用。
10.1021/acscatal.6c05520.en:
Based on the captured partial text; uncaptured details are not reconstructed.

The study uses alcohol-driven coordination tailoring to transform triphosphine-coordinated Ru sites on porous organic polymers into monophosphine-coordinated sites for amine N-alkylation with alcohols without added base. The authors describe the active configuration as [RuH2Cl2(Ph-CHO)(PPh3)]. The strategy changes the local coordination environment rather than merely increasing Ru loading.

The reported TOF and apparent activation energy for the monophosphine system are 323 h−1 and 70.1 kJ mol−1, compared with 145 h−1 and 103.3 kJ mol−1 for the triphosphine control. Recycling and characterization indicate that Ru remains atomically dispersed after 10 cycles. Intermediate, spectroscopic and computational analyses support the authors' proposed dihydride-transfer mechanism and connect improved activity with a lower β-hydride-elimination barrier. The active-structure and rate-determining-step interpretations cannot be inferred from the higher TOF alone.

The work provides a coordination-number-tuning strategy for heterogeneous single-atom Ru catalysts in organic N-alkylation. Activity and recyclability apply to the reported model and tested scope, not universal compatibility with all amines and alcohols.
10.1021/acscatal.6c05520.evidenceAudit: Checked coordination conversion and proposed structure, 323/145 h^-1 TOFs, 70.1/103.3 kJ mol^-1 apparent barriers and 10-cycle atomic dispersion. Distinguished measured performance from dihydride/β-H-elimination interpretation and avoided universal substrate claims.
